fusions.name: Arcane Sliver
fusions.desc: Fires a sliver of force that deals 4 damage, with a 15% chance to leave the target [Exposed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Through the Ward
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 7 tiles away for 30 damage that ignores resistance, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Quickened Weave
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Stray Spark
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, a spark leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 6 lightning damage. Once every 4 seconds.
